stock_contract: Ghidra decompilation, P-Code and Assembly entry 0012860c
limitations: The candidate is a typed transition with explicit proven offsets, but tcm_dev and the report object are still represented through an opaque layout view rather than independently reconstructed canonical GKI structures.

The harness covers 13 assertions across guards, parser disablement, format termination, scalar/object/global fields and invalid widths; callback, truncated-report, multi-object boundary and every error edge still require dedicated cases.
The Assembly emission covers the AArch64 ABI probe wrapper, not a relocation-equivalent build of the complete driver function.
Canonical module build, typed layout review, KCFI/relocation comparison, independent review and physical hardware validation remain required.
